newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish prison service buys 1.7 million condoms.
newsitem.headline: Spanish prison service buys 1.7 million condoms.

text.p: Spain's prison service has bought 1.7 million condoms at an auction to distribute among male prisoners, the Official State Bulletin said on Friday.

Inmates in Spanish prisons are allowed one visit a month from spouses or partners. Male inmates are given four condoms a month while in females' prisons condoms are available in rooms kept for conjugal visits.
